label: Kimi Plus (membership incl. Kimi Code)
harnesses: third-party via API key (OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible)
models: Kimi K3 (k3, k3-256k; 1M context needs Pro+)
limits: New plans with Kimi Code access (Plus and higher) have a rolling 5-hour usage limit and no weekly limit... Exhausting the monthly shared credit pool also affects Kimi Code. Both monthly and annual subscriptions refresh credits monthly, with no rollover.
notes: Help center prices were captured 2026-10-12: $19/mo, or $180/yr ($15/mo). The credit pool is shared with Kimi web features (Work, Deep Research, slides, Claw). The docs say: 'Please maintain the tool's real identity identifier... Tampering with the client identifier (User-Agent) is considered a violation.' Legacy tiers (Moderato and others) keep weekly limits. China CNY plans (Go ¥49 with no coding, Plus ¥99, Pro ¥199, Max ¥699) are secondary only and not included. Extra Usage is pay-as-you-go near API rates.
